title: Greg NDE 42
content:
The first few times I died and went through the void/curtain/wall that divides mortals with heaven- I saw a light and an old friend. All I was told, was that it was not my time. It was as if I was in a room w/no lights, sounds or feelings and all of a sudden, a white light and a shadow appeared that told me that it was not my time. This happened several times, maybe 5 times. The last time it happened I felt awake on the operating room table- I could hear the nurse and the doctor, the heart machine. I heard a female voice say we're losing him. Then I felt as if my soul> had been grabbed and pulled upwards to the ceiling. I was floating, I tried to look back- but that is not allowed. The sounds of the OR slowly faded- as if someone was turning down the volume control, slowly. I felt scared, but had a strange feeling of comfort or being told to be calm. I went through a dark tunnel where the light slowly became brighter. Then a shadow appeared- an old friend told me that it was not my time and then things went black/gone/etc. I somehow figured out that the shadow was a friend who died 5 years earlier. I am glad to see that he made it to heaven, he deserved it.

elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I felt transparent, or from what I saw when I looked back I seemed that way- I only caught a glimpse from looking back- but, it could explain why my friend was a shadow. He stood in front of the light so that he could have some kind of form.

elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Altered space- I went to heaven.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: Hearing from a deceased person is rather unusual.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes yes, some kind of tunnel/curtain/division or the earth and heavens.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes They were in front of the light. Yes, it was a friend who died 5 yrs. earlier. He told me repeatedly that it was not my time.

elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Yes, "heaven". Very nice place from the outside, I bet is really great on the inside.

elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future yes, but that has been a gift> for some time.

Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Yes, "heaven". Very nice place from the outside, I bet is really great on the inside. Yes it gave me a "god-complex".. Not only am I a prophet, I also believe that I am immortal. The experience included: Presence of unearthly beings After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Uncertain I have no problem talking about it- but I have to be careful of who I tell because I don't want to go to a loony bin. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Uncertain Well, I believe that I have a more direct line to "god". I have asked questions that only she/he/it/they could have answered. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? I do not know, yet. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Various reactions from; you should devote your life to god to you should feel lucky. Don't know how they were influenced. I don't tell many people- At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Just my memory Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? Can't think of anything.
